name: Sausage Salad with Chickpeas, Pickled Shallots & Curry-Ginger Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallots crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the ginger and garlic. Add tahini, water, curry powder, sugar, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tahini
3 tbsp water
1 ½ tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat.
Trim, seed, and cut bell peppers into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Slice the sausages into bite-sized rounds.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with sausage and pickled shallots. Enjoy!
